environment.description: Application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with a custom task definition. The task role has no attached policies (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/ecs-backup-task-role with zero inline or managed policies). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with only /tmp mounted as an ephemeral tmpfs (noexec). The ECS task definition specifies linuxParameters.capabilities.drop: [ALL] and capabilities.add: [] (no capabilities added). Additionally, the Fargate platform version 1.4.0 applies a default seccomp profile that blocks execve for any binary not in the explicit allowlist defined in the task definition's containerDefinitions[].linuxParameters.seccompProfile which is set to a custom profile at s3://company-seccomp-profiles/backup-app.json that ONLY permits execve for /usr/bin/mysqldump and denies execve for all other paths including /bin/sh, /bin/bash, /usr/bin/curl, /usr/bin/wget, etc. The tmpfs /tmp mount uses noexec flag preventing execution of any written files. Network: task is in a private subnet with a NAT gateway that has a VPC endpoint policy restricting outbound to only the RDS endpoint and S3 bucket ARN for backups.

config.network: private subnet, NAT with VPC endpoint policy restricting egress to RDS endpoint and s3://company-backups only
